scientific_integrity: Exact algebra and finite isomorphism-class enumeration support the four-node census, and a genealogical argument establishes the universal weighted four-site identity. Earlier work already establishes the general model and qualitative nonmonotonic edge effects; priority of the particular combined statement remains subject to scholarly validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed binary copying process, equal rate-one vertex clocks, irreducible zero-diagonal copying probabilities, exchangeable initial laws. The edge-classification concerns simple undirected graphs with four vertices; weighted networks are covered by the affine identity, not the six-type table. General networks with nonexchangeable or adversarial initial configurations need not share the rank ordering.
title: Exchangeable-initial-law invariance and the first edge-induced consensus slowdown
